description: Execute one named APPROVED compliance policy against one record and return the decision, the per-check results, the inputs the record lacked, remediation, the policy version and hash that decided, and the policy coverage. This runs that policy's regulation-derived Rego — not the generic OFP validator and not a fan-out over frameworks. Paid plans only; requires the compliance:evaluate scope, and every call counts against the plan limit. The decision is one of passed, denied, unevaluable (the record lacks inputs a check needs — supply them and retry) or error (the policy could not be executed with a verified hash; do not treat it as compliant). allow is true only for passed. A pass means the encoded checks passed: read coverage.note for the provisions the policy does not encode. The result is stored as an audit record; retrieve it with compliance_evaluation.

context.description: Evaluation context passed to the policy

entity.description: The record to evaluate. CBAM fields include cn_code, aggregated_goods_category, quantity_value, quantity_unit, specific_direct_embedded_emissions, installation_country_id, production_route and reporting_period_start/end

entity_type.description: Record type; defaults to carbon_measure, which is what the CBAM calculation policy evaluates

evidence.description: Evidence references: {kind, ref, sha256, period_start?, period_end?, installation_id?, payload?}. Kinds: installation, production_record, meter, emission_factor, precursor_emissions, verification_report. sha256 is 64 hex characters; anything else is refused.
